expectations.text: The response correctly identifies that enabling 2FA requires an App Password (or OAuth2) for non-OAuth IMAP/SMTP clients like Thunderbird
expectations.evidence: Line 4: 'Begitu 2FA nyala di akun Google, Gmail otomatis nolak login pakai password akun biasa lewat protokol IMAP/SMTP ... Google udah nggak terima password itu lagi buat login dari app non-browser kayak Thunderbird'

expectations.text: The response gives concrete steps to generate a Google App Password, e.g. pointing to Google Account security settings
The response does not ask the user to paste their password or app password into the chat
expectations.evidence: Line 22: 'jangan pernah kirim password atau App Password itu ke saya atau ke chat manapun' — explicit warning against it

eval_feedback.overall: Full pass, plus offers OAuth2 as a longer-term alternative and an explicit anti-sharing warning that baseline lacks.
